desc: Convert a Roman numeral to an integer. Symbols: I=1, V=5, X=10, L=50, C=100, D=500, M=1000 (uppercase only). The value is the sum of the symbols' values, except that a symbol whose value is smaller than the value of the symbol right after it is subtracted instead of added. Errors, checked in this order: "empty" if s is ""; "invalid character: C" for the first character C that is not one of the seven symbols; "not canonical" if the value is not between 1 and 3999 or s is not exactly the standard form of its value. The standard form of n writes it greedily with M=1000, CM=900, D=500, CD=400, C=100, XC=90, L=50, XL=40, X=10, IX=9, V=5, IV=4, I=1 (taking the largest that fits each time), e.g. 1994 is MCMXCIV.

decls.ts: type Result<T> = { ok: true; value: T } | { ok: false; error: string };
